name: zhongli_ic_drive
description: Reverse drive-time isochrones (6/8/10/12 min) to on-ramp entries of 國道1號 內壢/中豐/中壢 interchanges; unclipped.

properties.name: 內壢交流道
properties.engine: Valhalla 3.9.3 (FOSSGIS public instance; routing tiles built 2026-11-20T06:25Z; no traffic data)

params.locations: one request per ramp entry; routing point 15 m into the first ramp segment; heading = ramp bearing, heading_tolerance 45
params.exclude_polygons: 25 triangles (1.5 m) on freeway diverge/exit ramps within 24.89-25.05N, 121.13-121.31E, so the freeway itself cannot be used to reach an entry
params.union: shapely 2.0 unary_union of per-entry contours (after make_valid); areas in TWD97/TM2 (EPSG:3826 formulae)

properties.confidence_note: Valhalla matrix check at one contour: 28/29 near-boundary samples on the same side; edge offset median -44 m (range -160..+92 m). OSRM demo (same routes, median distance ratio 1.00) is ~31% faster (median time ratio 0.69).
properties.method: Reverse isochrone = area from which the ramp entry (where cars leave the surface road) can be reached by car within N minutes, free-flow model incl. Valhalla turn/intersection costs; no live or historical traffic. Freeway main lines excluded by blocking exits.
properties.data: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0); OSM base for ramp topology 2026-11-20T15:35Z
